# Data Integrity Checklist: SPEC-009A Workflow Contract Format and Roundtrip

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009A requirements define complete, clear, and measurable data-integrity guarantees for workflow contract import, export, diagnostics, and recovery.
**Created**: 2026-05-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Transactional Apply

- [ ] CHK001 Are apply-mode requirements explicit that validation and the complete diff are computed before any runtime mutation begins? [Completeness, Spec FR-039, Plan Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK002 Are transaction-boundary requirements clear that owned-template upserts/disables, diagnostics writes, and last-known-good snapshot writes occur inside one SQLite transaction? [Clarity, Spec FR-039, Data Model Runtime Workflow Template Projection]
- [ ] CHK003 Are failed-apply semantics measurable enough to prove no partial `workflow_templates`, diagnostics, or snapshot state is visible after rollback? [Measurability, Spec FR-019, Spec SC-001]
- [ ] CHK004 Are storage-failure outcomes aligned between requirements and CLI contract exit codes, including transaction rollback classification? [Consistency, Spec FR-038, Contracts CLI Exit Codes]

## Upsert Identity And Scope

- [ ] CHK005 Is the runtime upsert identity unambiguous as workspace plus template slug for every contract-owned workflow template? [Clarity, Spec FR-040, Data Model Canonical Workflow Template]
- [ ] CHK006 Are ownership-scope requirements specific enough to distinguish created, updated, disabled, unchanged, and unrelated runtime templates? [Completeness, Spec FR-017, Spec FR-018, Data Model Contract Diff]
- [ ] CHK007 Are unrelated `workflow_templates` preservation requirements stated in both user-facing acceptance criteria and technical design artifacts? [Consistency, Spec User Story 2, Plan Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK008 Can repeated apply of an unchanged valid contract be objectively assessed as idempotent and no-op preserving? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-004, Quickstart Verify No-Op Parity]

## Last-Known-Good Recovery

- [ ] CHK009 Are last-known-good snapshot requirements complete for successful apply, failed reload/import retention, and absent-snapshot behavior? [Completeness, Spec FR-021, Spec FR-022, Contracts Recovery]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the deterministic recovery command requirement clear about being recorded with every successful snapshot and reused by operator-triggered recovery? [Clarity, Spec FR-044, Data Model Workflow Contract Snapshot]
- [ ] CHK011 Are recovery-mode requirements consistent with import apply by requiring dry-run first and explicit apply for mutation? [Consistency, Spec FR-045, Contracts Recovery]
- [ ] CHK012 Can recovery success and no-last-known-good states be measured through diagnostics and quickstart expectations? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-006, Quickstart Recover Last Known Good]

## Canonical Hash Parity

- [ ] CHK013 Is the canonical hash envelope fully defined, including algorithm, envelope version, stable sorted JSON input, and excluded runtime/local fields? [Completeness, Spec FR-041, Data Model Parity Hash Set]
- [ ] CHK014 Are per-template routing-rule and output-schema hash requirements distinct from the canonical object hash? [Clarity, Spec FR-042, Contracts Workflow Contract YAML And Canonical Model]
- [ ] CHK015 Are no-op import/export parity requirements measurable across repeated unchanged runs rather than Markdown byte equality? [Measurability, Spec FR-026, Spec SC-004, Research Versioned Canonical Hash Envelope]
- [ ] CHK016 Are hash requirements consistent across dry-run, apply, export, diagnostics, and generated Markdown review output? [Consistency, Spec FR-025, Contracts CLI Success Output]

## Diagnostics Persistence And Migration

- [ ] CHK017 Are diagnostics persistence requirements complete for run summaries, filterable errors, and last-known-good canonical snapshots? [Completeness, Spec FR-046, Spec FR-047, Spec FR-048]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the diagnostics migration requirement clear that schema additions use additive migration `071_workflow_contract_diagnostics` with matching rollback SQL or a documented migration-id rebase? [Clarity, Spec FR-049, Plan Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK019 Are diagnostics re-run requirements represented by durable run records for import, export, recovery, success, validation failure, storage failure, and no-last-known-good states? [Coverage, Data Model Workflow Contract Run, Contracts Diagnostics API And UI]
- [ ] CHK020 Are redaction and truncation requirements present for diagnostics details that may contain prompt bodies or secret-like values? [Non-Functional, Spec FR-052, Data Model Workflow Contract Run Error]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK021 Do spec, plan, data model, CLI contract, diagnostics contract, and quickstart agree that dry-run never mutates `workflow_templates`? [Consistency, Spec FR-016, Contracts Import, Quickstart Dry-Run Import]
- [ ] CHK022 Do the artifacts consistently keep Markdown export non-canonical and excluded from canonical hash input? [Consistency, Spec FR-002, Spec FR-041, Contracts Canonical YAML Location]
- [ ] CHK023 Are acceptance criteria sufficient to cover changed, invalid, successful, repeated no-op, absent-snapshot, and unrelated-template states? [Scenario Coverage, Spec Acceptance Scenarios, Spec Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK024 Are data-integrity requirements bounded to SPEC-009A contract roundtrip behavior without introducing product-line seed, dispatch, runner, sandbox, or harness execution scope? [Scope, Spec FR-030, Plan Post-Design Constitution Check]
